model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-E (%) scores for different language models with and without Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) applied to datasets denoted as D₀, D₁, and D₂. The horizontal axis displays the model names—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-E (%)”, presents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each model, four bars are grouped together; “no SFT” is represented by a blue bar, “+ SFT on D₀” by a yellow bar, “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” by a light purple bar, and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” by a red bar. The “no SFT” bar for LLaMA-2-7B is approximately 6%, while the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar for LLaMA-2-70B reaches approximately 45%. The bars are arranged in groups representing each model, and all bars within a group have the same width and are vertically aligned. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
